text:
maria_ae: hey team — running into a procurement snag with State University. they will only pay via their procurement system and insist on an invoice from Redwood (not AWS). also asking for a formal tax-exempt certificate and a 20% EDU discount on a 12-month seat commit. they want net-45. can deal desk/finance confirm which of these we can accommodate and what paperwork we need? cc @tom_se @kevin_dealdesk :wave:

tom_se: quick context — State U wants Redwood to appear as the vendor on the invoice (billing addr + tax id). AWS Marketplace PO flow invoices from AWS, so that won't satisfy them unless AWS can pass through a vendor invoice (rare).

kevin_dealdesk: short answer: we can do a direct/vendor invoice (offline purchase) if finance & legal sign off. marketplace private offers are great for pricing control but still bill via AWS. if customer strictly rejects AWS invoices, we should route as a direct contract. need ARR, SKUs, and proposed discount to run approval. :thinking_face:

sara_finance: finance checklist — vendor invoice path requires: vendor setup form, W9 (or W-8), Redwood billing entity we should use (Redwood Inference, Inc. or Redwood Inference LLC?), Redwood TAX ID, and tax-exempt certificate from the buyer. lead time: 7–10 business days to create vendor account and generate the first invoice once we have signed order/form.

lisa_procurement: lisa_procurement (State U) — confirmed: our standard AP will not process invoices from marketplaces. we can do net-45, and we will attach the tax-exempt cert to the PO. we also need a line-item breakdown (SKU, unit price, qty, term) so our system maps to the PO lines. legal will require our standard IP/data addendum; happy to share their template after the quote. :+1:

maria_ae: thanks — the ask from customer: 150 seats, 12 months, start date May 1, list price per seat $120/mo. requested 20% off list for EDU. Tom — can SE confirm which SKUs we should surface to procurement so lines match accounting?

tom_se: suggest one line per seat SKU: "rwinf-seat-monthly", quantity 150, unit price $120, term 12 months. we usually map rate card like this in the quote. if discount applied at quote level we can show discounted unit price. i'll paste a PO template for them to copy:

```
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Billing address: 123 Redwood Way, SF, CA 94107
Tax ID: 12-3456789
Item: rwinf-seat-monthly
Qty: 150
Unit price: $96.00 (after 20% EDU discount)
Term: 12 months (May 1 2026 - Apr 30 2027)
Total: $173,280.00
Payment terms: Net 45
Special notes: Vendor invoice required; do not route via AWS Marketplace
```

kevin_dealdesk: thanks Tom. to approve 20% EDU discount as an exception we'll need: (1) signed order form or PO referencing Redwood as vendor, (2) minimum ARR threshold — for 150 seats at $96/mo = $173k ARR for 12 months, that's above our internal threshold so OK from a $ perspective, (3) sales leader sign-off. i'll draft an approval and route to finance/legal. please attach the customer's PO when available. :thumbsup:

sara_finance: addendum: we can issue invoices directly to the university and accept net-45. we need procurement's billing contact and their AP email to set up auto-send. also need the tax-exempt certificate as a PDF. invoice cadence? monthly invoices are fine or a single annual invoice if they prefer. which does customer want?

lisa_procurement: monthly invoices preferred. we'll include AP contact on the PO. legal said the university standard terms are fine if you accept a limited data addendum; i'll send ours once i have the quote.

maria_ae: action items: (1) kevin to route discount approval (deal desk) — please cc finance/legal, (2) tom to generate a formal quote with line items and discounted unit price and attach Redwood vendor info, (3) sara to begin vendor onboarding after we get PO + W9 + tax-exempt cert, (4) maria to collect procurement contact + PO when they raise it. i'll get the PO template over to them after kevin confirms approval. timeframe: customer wants contract signed by 04/20.

kevin_dealdesk: i'll move on approval now. if you can drop the exact quote PDF (signed by AE) in DealHub and tag me, i'll route for final sign-off. once approved i can attach special terms to the quote (EDU discount clause) and push to legal for a simple order form.

tom_se: i'll build the quote now and share a PDF by EOD. note: if at any point the customer flips to AWS marketplace (they sometimes prefer vendor-managed private offers), we can still create a Private Offer for pricing control, but procurement's invoice requirement means direct contracting is cleaner.

maria_ae: perfect — thanks everyone. lisa, i'll send the PO template and the quote once kevin confirms. any blockers call out now? :eyes:

lisa_procurement: no blockers from procurement side once vendor invoice flow is confirmed. i'll await the quote and tax-exempt cert. thanks.

kevin_dealdesk: approved pending the standard deal desk checklist — i'll update the thread when final. :white_check_mark:
